title: Leave the worker's AI out of the board

options.label: The agent writes a short line; questions go back to it
options.act: Contract: `short` (≤80 chars) per card; no worker AI on the board
options.then: Ask the agent for a short line on every card, and send phone questions back to it.

options.label: Summarise cards on the phone with the worker's /prompt

why: The worker's /prompt runs one Sonnet call with no tools, and it hides "I don't know" answers. It's good for Fuchi's Ask AI, but wrong for the board: the agent that wrote the card already knows its context, and a second model summarising it could lose the very nuance you're deciding on. Instead, the agent writes a short line on every card for small screens (the lock screen, the Watch, the menu bar), and Ask the agent on the phone sends your question back to the agent in your note, as on the Mac.
